author: dimension11studios
title: Hiring Character Artist for Legends of Orisha
content: WE'RE HIRING! We're looking for a Character Artist to join the team working on Legends of Orisha: Blood and Water. If you're skilled in 3D character modelling, sculpting, texturing, and Unreal Engine, this could be a great fit! Experience with MetaHuman, realistic 4C hair, African hairstyles, and character materials is a big plus. Remote. Long-term collaboration. Interested? Find the full job description and application details through the link in our bio.

author: emilygraceillustration
title: Storyboard Artist Wanted for Animatic
content: STORYBOARD ARTIST WANTED! I'm looking for a talented freelance storyboard artist to collaborate on a short proof-of-concept animatic for an original animated action-adventure series. I'm particularly keen to hear from artists who specialise in dynamic action sequences, cinematic composition and strong character moments. This is a paid opportunity for a small, creator-led project. If you're interested, or know someone who might be a great fit, please get in touch or tag them below. Please share your portfolio/reel and rates via DM.

author: akimboart
title: Call for Mural Artist - Tom Thomson 150
content: Call for Expressions of Interest: Tom Thomson 150 – Canoe Lake Mural. @tomthomsonartgallery, in partnership with @algonquinoutfitters, invites professional visual artists and muralists residing in Canada to submit an Expression of Interest for an original outdoor public art mural at the Algonquin Outfitters Canoe Lake store in Algonquin Park, Ontario. Total Project Budget: $10,000. Deadline: December 18, 2026, 11:59pm ET. The commission will be awarded through a two-stage open competition. For full details and how to submit, please visit the link in bio.

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists and More
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE. We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. These positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. These positions are paid but we’re open to collaboration / internships. Please send a *PROFESSIONAL* email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with name, location, position, resume/portfolio, rates, turnaround, software, payment method, etc. NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE. ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE.
